name: REGISTRE
description: Authoritative analytical editorial system with horizontal navigation, ruled white surfaces and an always-visible desktop parameter/source rail.

layout.navigation: Horizontal primary text navigation with 3px current-view underline; wraps into independent horizontal scrolling on narrow phones.
layout.analysis: 288px fixed configuration rail plus flexible result surface; 260px at intermediate desktop widths. Source remains visible above both. Mobile stacks a closed configuration disclosure followed by legible chart/table results.
layout.dashboard: Broad analytical grid: grouped means plus exact table at left, counts and overall mean at right; lower row joins missingness and IQR provenance. No metric tiles.
layout.assistant: Conversation and selected-presentation dossier in parallel on desktop; dossier precedes conversation on mobile to expose provenance and recorded price before the composer.

states.hover: Restrained pale-blue fill and darker control border
states.disabled: Gray text/fill; unavailable save after configuration changes
states.changed: Results cleared immediately; explicit calculation required
states.loading: Static skeleton specimen in system view
states.error: Readable pale-red inline specimen with explicit retry simulation
states.empty: Inline explanation and filter reset simulation
states.unsaved: Native dialog; Stay preserves current fields and Discard allows navigation
states.save: Explicit simulation announcement, never a persisted-success claim

motion.purpose: Bar width transition only when fixture state changes; reduced-motion removes transitions; no page entrance sequence

prototype.dashboardFilters: Precomputed all/A/B states; IQR reference remains entire v1 and is explicitly labeled

tradeoffs: Dense explicit source and method information uses more vertical space than a summary card layout.
Horizontal navigation is clear for the three proposed views; more production destinations would need deliberate grouping.
Mobile intentionally prioritizes the selected medication dossier before conversation history; future usability review should verify this ordering.

success.behavior: Persistent contextual text naming the confirmed operation and saved revision; never inferred from Calculate or a local simulation

warning.behavior: Explicit consequence and next action, color accompanied by text

validation.behavior: Linked summary and field-specific instruction; aria-invalid and aria-describedby; retain current input

proposedFeedback.unknownOutcome: Explain uncertainty; read-only verification before explicit retry, no automatic mutation replay

proposedChartSystem.continuousScale: Light neutral through the primary data hue; explicit numeric legend and units
proposedChartSystem.redundancy: Text labels, line dashes/point markers and exact tables; do not rely on hue alone
proposedChartSystem.scope: Proposal for all existing chart types; the HTML specimens demonstrate bars only, plus exact tables/missingness. No production palette adopted.

centralVerification: REVIEW.md, browser-verification.json and review-verification.json; candidate remains unapproved
